none: PAS NLM-C34546: Early Medieval Coin: Penny of Cnut
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Penny of Cnut (1016-1035), as kindly identified by the finder, moneyer Godric at Lincoln mint, cf. Mossop et al . 1970, plate 43 nos 4-12. Obverse description: Profile helmeted and draped bust left with sceptre in front of face; initial cross pattee. Obverse inscription: +CNVT REX. Reverse description: Voided short cross with central plain feature and a ring and pellet in each angle.…
